created_prompt:
Hi, my friend Julie needs help devising a direct and clear three year plan. She posts healthy-related cooking videos on social media and has 1.2 million followers. She wants to continue growing online and eventually publish a cookbook.

The problems she faces is that she works 4 days weekly and has a smaller budget. She also doesn't know whether her cookbook should be traditionally or self published.

Help create a plan that helps overcome her problems, provides important feedback on publishing, and gives her direct steps she can follow to reach her goals by the end of the 3 years.
